 Where is the Casino in GTA 6? Location, Explained
 You’re probably committing many sins playing GTA 6, so what would one more be by gambling in a casino? The previous Grand Theft Auto game had a prolific casino, but that doesn’t mean GTA 6 does.
 The day The Diamond Heist & Casino Resort opened in GTA Online was a literal game-changer. Horse racing, card games, slots, tables—you name it, the casino had it. GTA 6 seems to have everything in the sequel, and I’m sure many of you are already keen to wager your hard-earned money.
 You can buy Grand Theft Auto 6 here if you haven’t already!
 Does GTA 6 Have A Casino?
 Credit to Rockstar Games 
 Merlin’s Palace Casino is an existing casino you can find in GTA 6. 
 Unlike The Diamond Heist & Casino Resort in GTA 5, which was under construction, Merlin’s Palace Casino is fully built. It currently exists in Grand Theft Auto 6, and you can go and visit it right now!
 More Insider Gaming: All GTA 6 Guides, Walkthroughs, Best Tips & Tricks 
 Find out where it is further on.
 Where is the Casino in GTA 6? Location, Explained
 The Vice-Dale County region of Leonida is where you’ll find the casino in Vice City. 
 Thanks to ARCHIS on YouTube, you can see the exact location of the Merlin’s Palace Casino on the map. It’s slightly northwest of Lowballer Customs in Vice-Dale County.
 See how to get to it here.
 Can You Go Into Casinos in GTA 6?
 The Merlin’s Palace Casino is closed in GTA 6, and it doesn’t appear you can access it at any point during the story .
 You can go there, look at it, admire it, and picture yourself gambling in it, but that’s the closest you’ll come to physically wagering any money. It might not be locked forever, though.
 Why is the Casino Closed in GTA 6?
 Rockstar Games has confirmed that the game’s story didn’t feel right to add such a major gambling element. 
 Rockstar VP of design, Stephen Donkin, explained to Kotaku that the overall map is built for the ‘future,’ and how gambling and the casino factor into this:
 ‘Jason and Lucia’s story didn’t feel like the right place for us to introduce gambling. Especially with the fine balance we sought throughout the economy.
 The map has been built for the long term and with many factors in mind. So there are a few areas on the map that give us options in the future should we have a gameplay or narrative need for them.’
 Like GTA 5, GTA 6 will not have an active casino, at least not right away. It took six years for The Diamond Casino & Resort to open in GTA Online. It appears GTA is going to have online multiplayer, maybe as GTA Online 2 , but it’s unclear if the casino will open at all—although I’d suspect it will.
